Question 14
?

Which of the following expressions gives all of the vertical asymptotes of the function f(x)=tan⁡(4x+π4)? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=π4+nπ4
b
x=π16+nπ16
c
x=π8+nπ8
d
x=π16+nπ4
e
x=π4+nπ8
